name: Sertraline (Zoloft)
description: SSRI antidepressant (selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor) taken by mouth

note.text: A 2019 pooled analysis of 14 trials covered 977 men with PE. Most trials lasted 4 to 8 weeks.

bullets: **Blocks serotonin reuptake** by nerve cells, per the label
**Very weak effects** on noradrenaline and dopamine
**Delayed ejaculation** is a known SSRI side effect, the basis for PE studies
PE: small RCTs of 36 to 147 men

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 4.5 to 8.4 hours; extensively metabolized
practical.monitored: Mood and suicidal thoughts, sodium, bleeding, sexual effects

regulatory.text: Approved 1991 for 6 psychiatric uses; PE off-label
Oct 2026: warning on lasting sexual problems

references: Yi et al., Medicine (Baltimore), sertraline for PE meta-analysis, Jun 2019
MHRA, Drug Safety Update on antidepressants, Oct 2026
